en.title: IRS launches new mobile app, expanding digital services for taxpayers
en.summary: The IRS today announced the launch of the new IRS mobile app, replacing IRS2Go and expanding the agency’s digital services to give taxpayers more ways to securely access IRS tools and account services from their mobile devices.

en.title: Statement on IRS operations limited during the lapse in appropriations; regular tax deadlines remain
en.summary: Due to the current lapse in appropriations, IRS operations are limited. However, the underlying tax law remains in effect, and all taxpayers must continue to meet their tax obligations as normal.

en.title: Temporary reporting and recordkeeping relief for certain fuel uses
en.summary: The Internal Revenue Service today announced temporary administrative relief from reporting and recordkeeping requirements relating to taxes imposed by section 4041(a) of the Internal Revenue Code.

es.title: El IRS lanza nueva aplicación móvil y amplía servicios digitales para contribuyentes
es.summary: El IRS anunció hoy el lanzamiento de la nueva aplicación móvil IRS, la cual reemplaza a IRS2Go y amplía los servicios digitales de la agencia para ofrecer a los contribuyentes más formas de acceder de manera segura a las herramientas y servicios de cuenta del IRS desde sus dispositivos móviles.

es.title: Declaración acerca de las operaciones del IRS limitadas durante el lapso de asignaciones presupuestarias; los plazos tributarios para contribuyentes se mantienen vigentes
es.summary: Debido al lapso actual en las asignaciones presupuestarias, las operaciones del IRS son limitadas.

es.title: Temporary reporting and recordkeeping relief for certain fuel uses
es.summary: The Internal Revenue Service today announced temporary administrative relief from reporting and recordkeeping requirements relating to taxes imposed by section 4041(a) of the Internal Revenue Code.
